fusions.name: Waggle Signal
fusions.desc: Fires a sting that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it reaches and leaves it [Marked] for 15 seconds. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Drilled Formation
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings in a tight spread, each dealing 3 damage, with 25% more critical chance against a target not yet hurt, and 10% more damage for each ally near you, up to 30%. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Shared Lesson
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and has 1 more Power for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed by Many
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
